title: Sprout Phase Handoff
description: Phase handoff file written to docs/tasks/.sprout/ by a sprout subagent after completing its phase. Both the subagent write-side and the orchestrator read-side validate against this schema.

phase.description: Name of the sprout phase that produced this handoff (e.g. 'context', 'seed', 'tasks').

paths.description: File paths produced or modified by this phase. Empty array when the phase produces no files.

status.description: Outcome of the phase. 'success': phase completed and files are ready. 'failed': phase encountered an error. 'skipped': phase was intentionally not run.

errors.description: Error messages from this phase. Empty array on success or skipped; one or more messages on failed.

errors: to-tasks skill exited with non-zero status: schema validation failed
